decisions.reason: The certified HVAC plate exchanger line sits close to the core offer and serves a market supported by energy-efficiency demand, so despite no website visibility in 2020-2021 there is no clear shortfall against aspiration that would trigger search.
The marine box cooler builds on a claimed major market share in water cooling systems, which indicates performance at or above aspiration, so management has no reason to withdraw it.
The compact oil cooler line uses established competences, and a growing, hiring firm has enough slack to carry it, even though its lack of visibility since 2019 makes its results uncertain.
The finned tube is a component that supports the core air cooler business and had a dedicated page, so absent evidence of underperformance it is kept.
